root_cause: Metadata neuron order was verified only when binding against a graph, allowing a decoded projection that could never bind.
encoding/json replaces invalid UTF-8 and unpaired UTF-16 escape sequences with U+FFFD before ordinary field validation; validating only the decoded strings was too late.
coverage: Tests were added and observed failing before changes to projection.go, json.go and mapping.go; unchanged regression tests pass after the fix.
